text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day before the Satsuki Sho, and Narita Taishin encounters a redheaded girl just as small as her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin finds herself under a barrage of comments telling her that no one expects anything from her or thinks she can win. Then the girl asks if all of that makes her want to give up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin responds that she won't give up just because of other people's opinions and that she'll put everyone to shame with her running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day, as if to make good on her words, Narita Taishin shows up to race with an intensity that overwhelms her two rivals.
